body: Imani (S024): live-found quality bug — simplify_tool_results keeps only the newest tool result verbatim and cuts every older result >400 chars to head+tail, so multi-part answers lose items (5-entry folder listing cut mid-list; glm invented 'theta', DeepSeek reported 4 folders).
